question: What analogy between the embodied soul and temple renewal is taught through the abandonment of a worn body?
premises: An embodied being abandons a worn-out body
Another body is taken in its place
This principle is taught in tradition
inference: Just as the embodied being abandons a worn body for another, renewal is required when structures decay.
plain_english: As the embodied being abandons a worn-out body and takes another, so it is taught.
